title: Does penicillamine lower blood lead?

grade.title: Small, uncontrolled, or single-source human evidence
grade.basis: One retrospective cohort, with frequent adverse reactions.

answerHtml: In a retrospective cohort, children treated with D-penicillamine had a 33 percent fall in blood lead over a mean of 76 days, and untreated children did not. Adverse reactions occurred in 33 percent, including leukopenia, rash, and platelet depression, and 10 percent stopped because of a reaction. This is not a randomized trial.

sections.heading: Study
sections.html: Shannon and colleagues (1988) compared 84 treated children with 37 untreated children. Blood lead was 25 to 40 µg/dL. Seventy-six percent of treated children reached 25 µg/dL or below. Ten percent were treatment failures. PMID 3361395, doi:10.1016/s0022-3476(88)83212-8.
